:::{#def-chord}
#### Chord

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ be a [function](sets-functions.qmd#def-function),
and let $x, y \in \reals^p$.
The **chord** of $f$ from $x$ to $y$
is the line segment (@def-line-segment) in $\reals^{p+1}$
from the point $(x, f(x))$ to the point $(y, f(y))$
of the [graph](sets-functions.qmd#def-graph) of $f$:
$$
\cb{\paren{t x + (1 - t) y,\ t f(x) + (1 - t) f(y)} : t \in [0, 1]}.
$$
Above the point $t x + (1 - t) y$,
the chord has height $t f(x) + (1 - t) f(y)$.

:::
